description:
[Filings Oracle] 8-K material-event alerts classified into categories an agent can act on: earnings, exec_change, material_agreement, acquisition_disposition, bankruptcy, delisting, cybersecurity, auditor_or_restatement, control_change, financing, restructuring_impairment, shareholder_vote, governance, reg_fd, other_events. Each event lists every item with its official label.

**Example:** `/v1/8k-events?category=bankruptcy&days=7`

Use when you want 8-K material events already classified (earnings, exec change, material agreement and similar). Not for all form types (use filings_search).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

category.description: Optional. One of the category names above. Default all.

days.description: Optional. Look back N days (default 2, max 90). Ignored when since is set.

since.description: Optional. Cursor from meta.cursor of a previous response.

wait.description: Optional. With since: long-poll up to N seconds (max 25).

name: filings_8k_events
